text: Hi Professor Alvarez — Diego here. I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my calendar, I have these open half-hours inside working hours: Monday 10:00-10:30, Monday 14:00-14:30, Tuesday 11:00-11:30, Tuesday 15:00-15:30, Friday 11:00-11:30. Would one of those work for you? If not, tell me a slot that suits you and I'll fit around it.
Hi Diego — Monday 10:00-10:30 works. I've put it in my calendar: Monday 10:00-10:30, 1:1 with you. See you then.
Perfect — Monday 10:00-10:30 is in my calendar. Thanks, Professor. See you then.
